Three cases the scenarios don't cover are left unchosen and listed in the report under `## Open questions`:

- **"Not yet applied" wording:** r102's text says "not yet applied", but the code checks "spec/ does not hold". The two differ for an id spec/ holds whose proposal is not applied.
- **Other branches:** drafts that exist only on another initiative's branch are not read.
